newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian railways extends Thalys high-speed network.
newsitem.headline: Belgian railways extends Thalys high-speed network.

text.p: Belgian national railways company SNCB/NMBS said on Friday it would extend its high-speed Thalys train network to Paris from December 14.

From then on two trains a day would run from Ostend via Bruges, Ghent and Brussels to Paris, and two from Paris to Ostend. During weekends and holidays the frequency would to drop to one train in either direction.

In addition the line would be extended to Namur. Two trains a day would run from Namur via Charleroi and Mons to Paris, and two from Paris to Namur. During weekends and holidays the frequency on this line would also to drop to one train in either direction.
Currently, Thalys connections to Paris start in Brussels only.
